description: Weekly update PR for the homelab compose images, run by .github/workflows/renovate.yaml (its cron is the schedule — no `schedule` here, so a manual dispatch also opens PRs). The nix manager bumps flake.lock inputs in a second grouped PR (each input tracks the branch named in its `ref`, so release branches are never crossed). Merging does not deploy — run `just deploy` afterwards.

nix.description: The nix manager is beta and ships enabled: false; listing it in enabledManagers is not enough (first run on 2026-09-28 extracted only docker-compose).

packageRules.description: One PR per week for everything non-major, so there is a single item to review.
flake.lock bumps go in their own weekly PR (replaces the old update-flake-lock workflow); Eval/Build gate it.
Major versions can carry migrations for stateful services; wait until ticked on the Dependency Dashboard.
linuxserver tags are v<app>-ls<build>; treat the ls build number as part of the version.
